# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import json, os, re
d=json.load(open(r'C:/Users/Administrator/.dsh/cache/memory-audit/select.json',encoding='utf-8'))
ROOT=r'D:\repository'
all_dirs=[x for x in os.listdir(ROOT) if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(ROOT,x))]
SKIP={'node_modules','dist','.git','build','.nuxt','uni_modules','.hbuilderx','unpackage'}
cache={}

def match_proj(name):
    if not name: return []
    name=name.strip().rstrip('。.')
    if name in all_dirs: return [name]
    out=[x for x in all_dirs if name in x]
    if not out:
        out=[x for x in all_dirs if x in name]
    return out

def index_proj(pdir):
    if pdir in cache: return cache[pdir]
    files={}
    base=os.path.join(ROOT,pdir)
    for dp,dns,fns in os.walk(base):
        dns[:]=[x for x in dns if x not in SKIP]
        for fn in fns:
            if re.search(r'\.(vue|js|ts|json|scss|css|jsx|tsx)$',fn):
                fp=os.path.join(dp,fn)
                rel=os.path.relpath(fp,base).replace('\\','/')
                try: files[rel]=open(fp,encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore').read()
                except: pass
    cache[pdir]=files
    return files

out=[]
for i,c in enumerate(d['candidates']):
    content=c['content']
    m=re.search(r'所属项目[:：]\s*([^；;\n]+)',content)
    proj=m.group(1).strip() if m else ''
    projs=match_proj(proj)
    out.append(f"\n===== [{i:02d}] {c['uri'].split('/')[-1]} | proj={proj} | matched={projs}")
    fmentions=set(re.findall(r'([\w\u4e00-\u9fff./-]+\.(?:vue|js|ts|json|scss|css))',content))
    basenames=set(os.path.basename(x) for x in fmentions)
    ticks=set(x.strip() for x in re.findall(r'`([^`]+)`',content) if len(x.strip())>3 and not x.strip().endswith(('.vue','.js','.ts')))
    if not projs:
        out.append('  NO_PROJECT_MATCH')
        continue
    for p in projs[:1]:
        files=index_proj(p)

        hitb=sorted(b for b in basenames if b in base_names)
        missb=sorted(b for b in basenames if b not in base_names)
        out.append(f"  FILE hit({len(hitb)}): {hitb[:14]}")
        out.append(f"  FILE MISS({len(missb)}): {missb[:14]}")
        for t in sorted(ticks)[:20]:
            cnt=sum(1 for txt in files.values() if t in txt)
            out.append(f"  SYM[{cnt}] {t}")

open(r'C:/Users/Administrator/.dsh/cache/memory-audit/evidence.md','w',encoding='utf-8').write('\n'.join(out))
print('done lines=',len(out),'projects indexed=',list(cache.keys()))
